results.title: Thailand Sets Tolls for Fifth Lao–Thai Friendship Bridge
results.content: Thailand will begin collecting tolls starting at THB 50 (USD 1.46) on 1 December for vehicles crossing the Fifth Lao–Thai Friendship Bridge, according to Thailand’s Bueng Kan District. The new fee schedule covers the Mekong River crossing linking Thailand’s Bueng Kan Province with Laos’ Bolikhamxay Province, following a ministerial regulation published in Thailand’s Royal Gazette […]

results.title: Laos Leaves World’s Poorest Countries List After 55 Years
results.content: On 24 November, Laos formally left the United Nations’ Least Developed Countries (LDC) category, ending 55 years on the list it joined in 1971. Laos first met graduation thresholds in 2018 and cleared all three criteria in 2021: income, human assets, and economic and environmental vulnerability.
